[Verse 1]
[Dm]One man on a
lonely platform
[F]One case sitting
[Am]by his side
[Dm]Two eyes staring
cold and silent
[F]Show fear as he
[Am]turns to hide

[Chorus]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]

[Verse 2]
[Dm]Un homme dans une
gare isolee
[F]Une valise a ses
[Am]cotes
[Dm]Des yeux fixes et froids
[F]Mentre de la peur lors-
[Am]qu'il
Se tourne pour se ca-
cher

[Chorus]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]

[Bridge]
[Am]Sent la pluie comme un ete Anglais
Entends les notes d'une chanson lointaine
Sortant de derriere d'un poster
Esperant que la vie ne fut aussi

[Chorus]
[C]longue
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]

[Verse 3]
[Dm]Feel the rain like an
English summer
[F]Heal the notes from a
[Am]distant song
[Dm]Stepping out from a
back shop poster
[F]Wishing life wouldn't
[Am]be so long

[Chorus]
[C]
[Em]We fade to grey
[Am]
